text:
sara_cs: Kicking off Cetus Therapeutics dedicated bring-up. Contract signed; customer wants conservative ramp and a dry-run. Need quota proposal, autoscale rules, and a short load-test playbook. Renewal review in 6 weeks. Who owns quota sizing?
liam_ops: I can take quota sizing. please share traffic mix (embeddings vs gen), avg token lengths, and nightly batch patterns.
sara_cs: Mix is 55% embeddings (search), 45% gen (chat). Steady-state ~50 qps, bursts to 320 qps for 3-7m. Embedding batch at night: ~2500 rps for ~12m. Gen average 450 tokens, tail up to 2.8k.
arya_eng: Recommend split pools: gen pool base 6 GPUs, embed workers 3 smaller instances. Autoscale triggers: gen scale +2 when 95p latency > 350ms sustained 45s; scale-down cooldown 5m. For embeddings, separate autoscale: add embed workers when embed qps > 1800 sustained 30s.
tom_sre: Load test plan: (1) 18h shadow replay to seed KV + embed caches; (2) embedding blast 10m@3k rps; (3) gen stepped soak 5m rungs at 75/300/450 concurrent. Monitor 99/95/50p latencies, GPU util, queue length, and error rates.
lucy_fin: Finance wants three cost scenarios (current, onboarded expected, +30% growth) and delta with KV caching on/off. Need quota draft for cost inputs by EOD Thu.
sara_cs: timeline idea: quota draft Thu EOD, shadow Fri morning, soak Fri afternoon, go-live Mon. Does that work?
liam_ops: I can post draft Thu EOD. For immediate calc: reserve 6 GPUs base, burst buffer +3, embed pool 2 workers with +2 buffer. Will refine with token-rate spreadsheet.
arya_eng: Canary policy: route 10% traffic to 2-GPU canary for 20m, validate error-rate < 0.2% and 99p latency within 20% of baseline. If fail, fallback to quantized model automatically.
tom_sre: Note we had a metric aggregator lag issue previously that delayed scale-up. Patch 2026.06 fixed most cases but we'll monitor aggregator-lag metric during shadow. Abort if lag > 2s.
sara_cs: can we run the shadow on the dedicated pool only? we must not touch prod.
opsbot: shadow job created: cetus-shadow-1865 (ETA 2h).
liam_ops: Shadow only on dedicated pool, yes. Client must provide 48h sample or we synthesize patterns. Also will tag traffic and throttle origins.
arya_eng: stress tool note (use to exercise tail):
```
wrk -t10 -c400 -d10m --latency http://dedicated-cetus/v1/generate
```
Tune -c to represent concurrent streams during bursts.
lucy_fin: Also request: enable detailed token-level billing dashboard for this account for the renewal packet. I'll prepare the cost appendix once quota numbers are final.
sara_cs: action items: @liam_ops quota draft Thu EOD, @arya_eng add canary + fallback PR, @tom_sre schedule oncall for Fri 13:00-17:00, @lucy_fin prepare cost scenarios. I'll send customer update after quota sign-off.
liam_ops: posting draft soon: https://redwood.internal/drive/cetus-quota-v1 (comments welcome) :thumbsup:
opsbot: deploy/bastion check: no infra maintenance during Fri 13:00-17:00 window.
sara_cs: thanks all. small ask: include 5 regression prompts to check quality during soak.
arya_eng: added prompt set to PR.
tom_sre: i'll kick off shadow once we have the sample. ping here when uploaded.
sara_cs: will collect sample today and update thread. cheers :rocket:
